 Voting Alert for Sussex County Election District 36-01 Voters
 Department of Elections  |  Department of Elections - Sussex County Office  |  Newsroom  |  Sussex County | Date Posted: Monday, October 26, 2026
 Listen 
 Voting Alert for Sussex County Election District 36-01 Voters: 
 Election Day Polling Place Changed from Lulu Ross Elementary School to Mispillion Elementary School Due to Fire 
 GEORGETOWN, DE – Due to a devasting fire at Lulu Ross Elementary School over the weekend, the Department of Elections Sussex County Office has relocated the polling place of Sussex County Election District 36-01 voters for the November 3, 2026, General Election to Mispillion Elementary School at 311 Lovers Lane, Milford, Delaware 19963 . 
 The Department of Elections Sussex County Office has mailed letters to all registered voters in Sussex County Election District 36-01 informing them of the change of polling place. Please contact the Department’s Sussex County office at 302-856-5367 or votesc@delaware.gov for more information. 
 Polling Places statewide will be open on General Election Day, November 3, 2026, from 7:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. Voters must vote at their assigned polling places on election day. To find your polling place, please visit https://de.gov/voteplaces. 
 As a reminder, Early Voting for the 2026 General Election continues through Sunday, November 1, 2026. Voters may vote at any early voting site in their county of residence during the early voting period. Please see the Early Voting Schedule and list of Early Voting Sites listed below and at https://de.gov/evsites: 
 General Election Early Voting Dates & Times:
  October 26, 2026 – October 27, 2026, 7 a.m. – 7 p.m. 
  October 28, 2026 – November 1, 2026, 11 a.m. – 7 p.m.
